claims.claim_text: Strategic pivot away from in-house Li-Metal battery manufacturing toward AI-focused Molecular Universe platform; capital expenditures redirected from manufacturing equipment to AI infrastructure (GPU rental, software); reduced headcount; $4.0M decrease in OEM-JDA related lab equipment; $9.1M increase in AI infrastructure costs.
claims.subject: SES AI
claims.object_value: Capex shifted from battery manufacturing to AI infrastructure; battery-stack staff reductions
claims.source_quote: the current year strategic shift to AI focused spending which consisted of purchases of software and computer equipment, lab tools and instruments and AI related infrastructure. We expect capital expenditures to remain consistent in 2026 compared with 2025 as we continue to spend on AI related infrastructure rather than invest in manufacturing equipment.

claims.claim_text: Acquired UZ Energy (China BESS manufacturer) on September 15, 2025 for ~RMB 183.5M (~$25.8M); UZ Energy contributed approximately 35% of total revenue and 7% of total assets for FY2025.
claims.subject: SES AI
claims.object_value: UZ Energy acquired Sep 15, 2025, ~$25.8M; ~35% of FY2025 revenue
claims.source_quote: We completed the acquisition of UZ Energy on September 15, 2025... UZ Energy, which represented approximately 7% of total assets and 35% of total revenue of the consolidated financial statement amounts of the Company as of and for the year ended December 31, 2025.

claims.claim_text: Plan to develop NDAA-compliant drone cell manufacturing capacity in Korean facility for U.S. government and defense customers; framed as a future revenue driver but no announced contract or DoD program award.
claims.subject: SES AI
claims.object_value: NDAA-compliant drone cell manufacturing in Korea (planned, no awarded contract)
claims.source_quote: We are also planning to develop NDAA-compliant manufacturing capacity to develop drone cells with high energy and high-power density in our facility in Korea to meet the growing demand for NDAA-compliant cells. ... this initiative will require substantial capital investment and ongoing compliance costs, and there is uncertainty regarding the timing and magnitude of customer demand.
